ui.turnIntoAction: Turn this estimate into an action plan

pdf.title: My wedding
pdf.disclaimer: Indicative estimate — actual prices vary depending on your vendors and the season.

venue.name: Venue
venue.tip: Check what's included: tables, chairs, kitchen, sound system... it changes everything!
venue.off: Hosting at home or family property? Great, this item goes to €0 🏡

catering.name: Catering & meals
catering.tip: Average: €100/guest for a classic sit-down meal. In Paris, add +20-30%.

drinks.name: Drinks & alcohol
drinks.tip: Check if your caterer includes drinks. If not, buy directly from a winery to save!
drinks.off: Included with caterer? Make sure to verify in your contract ✅

cake.name: Wedding cake & desserts
cake.tip: A classic tiered cake is the most affordable. Custom wedding cakes look stunning but cost €10-20/person.

photographer.name: Photo & video
photographer.tip: The photographer is what remains when the party is over. Don't cut corners here!
photographer.off: A friend is handling it? Still brief several people with smartphones 📱

dj.name: Entertainment & music
dj.tip: Don't forget the ceremony officiant if you're planning one (€400-1,500)
dj.off: Spotify playlist and DIY vibes work great too! 🎶

flowers.name: Decoration & flowers
flowers.tip: Think about: bridal bouquet, boutonnière, ceremony arch, centerpieces, table runner, petals...

dress_bride.name: Bride's outfit
dress_bride.tip: Don't forget alterations (+€100-400) and accessories: veil, shoes, jewelry...

dress_groom.name: Groom's outfit
dress_groom.tip: Rental = €150-400. Purchase = keep it for other occasions!

rings.name: Wedding rings & jewelry
rings.tip: Price is for THE PAIR of rings. Expect €500-1,500 for classic gold.

beauty.name: Beauty
beauty.tip: Plan for trials (often paid) and home service on the day (common surcharge)!

stationery.name: Stationery & invitations
stationery.desc: Invitations, save the date, menus, seating chart
stationery.tip: Postage: €1.16/letter. Don't forget menus, seating chart, place cards, guestbook!

gifts.name: Favors & gifts
gifts.tip: Add ~€300 for witness gifts (2-6 people) and parents (often forgotten in the budget!)

transport.name: Transport & logistics
transport.tip: If your venue is remote, guest shuttles are often essential (and much appreciated!)

accommodation.name: Accommodation
accommodation.tip: Many venues include the wedding night. Check your contract!
accommodation.off: Night included at the venue? Great, direct savings! 🎉

kids.name: Children
kids.tip: A well-designed kids' area = parents who truly enjoy the evening 🙌
kids.off: No kids invited? That's fine too! 😄

admin.name: Admin & printing
admin.tip: Town hall paperwork is FREE. The big expense here: secular officiant if you're having both civil and religious ceremonies.

honeymoon.name: Honeymoon
honeymoon.tip: This amount is OUTSIDE the wedding budget. We show it separately for your overall view.
honeymoon.off: Trip postponed? You have a lifetime for that! 💛

contingency.name: Miscellaneous & contingency
contingency.desc: Umbrellas, medication, first aid kit, various surprises
contingency.tip: On average, couples spend 7% more than planned. Better to anticipate than to be caught off guard!

methodologie.title: Where do our numbers come from?
methodologie.subtitle: Full transparency on our methodology — because you deserve better than random estimates
methodologie.methoKeywords: wedding budget methodology, wedding costs 2026, budget calculation, reliable sources
methodologie.introP1: Wondering where our numbers come from? Great question — it's the same one we ask ourselves every time we see wedding estimates so scary they make you want to elope 😅
methodologie.introP2: Here, we believe in full transparency. Here's how we built this calculator, based on real sources and 2026 field pricing.
methodologie.sourcesTitle: 📊 Three sources that cross-check each other
methodologie.sourcesIntro: We don't make up numbers. Our estimates rest on three pillars:
methodologie.source1Item1: Mariages.net — The leading French annual barometer (2,000+ couples surveyed each year)
methodologie.source1Item2: Zankyou Wedding Report 2025 — International survey with detailed French data
methodologie.source1Item3: INSEE — Actual French household spending by category (government data)
methodologie.source2Title: 2. Field research, four times a year
methodologie.source2Intro: Every quarter (January, April, July, October), we call vendors directly to get real prices:
methodologie.source2Item1: 30+ reception venues across France (small, medium, large cities)
methodologie.source2Item5: DJs, entertainers, pastry chefs, various vendors
methodologie.source2Note: We collect 2026 base rates, calculate regional averages, and apply coefficients to account for local cost of living (Paris ≠ rural France). It's real work.
methodologie.source3Title: 3. You — real numbers from real weddings
methodologie.source3Text: If you use Kaatch to budget your wedding and share (completely anonymously) your actual expenses, they feed our future data. It's a virtuous circle: the more people use the calculator, the more accurate the estimates become.
methodologie.calcIntro: For each line item (photographer, DJ, flowers, etc.), we offer three budget tiers:
methodologie.calcNote: You select your tier for each item, and the calculator automatically compiles the total. Nothing magic, just smart addition.
methodologie.feature1: 19 detailed items — each with description, practical tip 💡, and 3 priced tiers
methodologie.feature2: 3 calculation types — fixed fee, cost per guest (×number of guests), or percentage of subtotal
methodologie.feature3: "I already have a quote" — enter your own amount to replace the estimate
methodologie.feature4: Honeymoon excluded from total — separated from main wedding budget for clarity
methodologie.feature5: Miscellaneous & contingencies — calculated as % of subtotal (5%, 8% or 12% depending on tier)
methodologie.feature6: Free reordering — drag and drop items in any order you like
methodologie.feature7: PDF export — download your complete estimate in one click
methodologie.regionsTitle: 📍 Prices vary enormously depending on where you are
methodologie.regionsIntro: Planning a wedding in Paris, Provence, or rural France... clearly not the same prices. Our calculator applies an automatic regional coefficient:
methodologie.regionsNote: When you enter your city or region, the calculator adjusts amounts automatically. It's fairer than a single average.
methodologie.updatesText: We re-contact our vendor network, collect updated prices (inflation, seasonality, current trends), and update the calculator. No fossilized data — we follow the real market.
methodologie.limitsIntro: This is an indicative estimate, not a quote. We wish the numbers were magically precise, but reality is more nuanced.
methodologie.limitsWhy: Your actual budget may vary because:
methodologie.limit1: You have specific tastes — Want a destination photographer? An ultra-specialized caterer? A vinyl-only DJ? It'll cost more.
methodologie.limit2: Seasonality matters enormously — May to September = +20-30% minimum. December and January drop.
methodologie.limit3: Unexpected costs always happen — Planning a 10-15% margin is wise.
methodologie.limit4: Vendors negotiate — Especially in off-season or if you bundle multiple services from the same person.
methodologie.limit5: Your micro-region may not be represented — If you live in a very remote or very touristy area, the average estimate may deviate.
methodologie.limitsConclusion: → Use this as a realistic starting point, not as absolute truth.
methodologie.whyFreeTitle: 💡 Why do we do this for free?
methodologie.whyFreeP1: Simple logic: if you have a reliable and reassuring estimate of the real cost of your wedding, you'll naturally want to organize it somewhere. And we truly believe that
methodologie.whyFreeLink: Kaatch is the ideal place to budget, track your expenses, and centralize everything.
methodologie.whyFreeP2: No pressure, no obligation. It's just common sense.
methodologie.feedbackP1: If your vendors give you prices that really diverge from our estimates, tell us — we love feedback and continuously improve our data.
methodologie.feedbackP2: Send an email to hello@kaatch.fr with: region + vendor type + actual price received.
methodologie.feedbackP3: Every piece of feedback improves the database for the next couples. Win-win.
